model_output.rationale: CO-29 on both lines; MOA N211. Filing indicator is CI (commercial) — N211's "no appeal" language is backed by 42 CFR 405.926 on Medicare FFS only; it carries no statutory force on a commercial claim. The 277CA (ACK75364521, 2025-01-27, status A2 / claim status 20) is a clearinghouse acceptance report showing the claim passed front-end edits 8 days post-DOS, well within any commercial timely-filing window. Per reference 03-timely-filing.md, this is the strongest proof of timely submission; dispute the payer's receipt date via formal appeal.

root_cause.explanation: Both lines denied CO-29. 277CA (ACK75364521, 2025-01-27) shows claim received with status A2/code 20 — 8 days post-DOS — contradicting the payer's untimely-filing assertion.

next_action.detail: File formal appeal attaching 277CA ACK75364521 (received 2025-01-27, A2, status code 20) as proof of timely receipt. Cite that N211 bars appeal only on Medicare FFS (42 CFR 405.926), not CI commercial. Dispute payer's receipt date; do not plead forgiveness.

evidence.fact: Lines 1–2 CO-29 ($138.62 total denied); MOA N211 ('you may not appeal this decision'); CI filing indicator.
Received date (DTP 050) 2025-01-27; status A2 (accepted for adjudication); claim status code 20; references TRC75364521 — 8 days post-DOS.
DOS 2025-01-19; filing indicator CI (commercial); no prior 277CA rejection in record.
Clearinghouse acceptance report is strongest proof of timely filing; N211's appeal bar is Medicare FFS only (42 CFR 405.926); commercial CO-29 with proof → appeal.

citations.rule: Proof of an accepted submission inside the window → appeal with the clearinghouse acceptance report; N211 no-appeal bar applies only to Medicare FFS under 42 CFR 405.926
Claim data right; determination wrong → appeal
